units.zh: 《後漢書》是一部記載東漢歷史的紀傳體史書。
units.en: The Book of Later Han is a biographical history that chronicles the Eastern Han dynasty.
units.literal: The 'Book of Later Han' is a biographical history recording the history of the Eastern Han dynasty.

units.zh: 書中分十紀、八十列傳和八志
units.en: The book consists of ten imperial annals, eighty biographies, and eight monographs
units.literal: The book is divided into ten annals, eighty biographies, and eight treatises

units.en: (continued by Sima Biao)
units.literal: (continued by Sima Biao)

units.zh: 紀和列傳的作者是南朝劉宋時的范曄。
units.en: Fan Ye, writing during the Liu Song dynasty of the Southern Dynasties, authored the imperial annals and biographies.
units.literal: The author of the annals and biographies is Fan Ye of the Liu Song period of the Southern Dynasties.

units.zh: 北宋真宗時，有人把晉朝司馬彪的《續漢書》八志三十卷與之合刊，成為今天的《後漢書》。
units.en: During Emperor Zhenzong's reign in the Northern Song, the thirty volumes of eight monographs from Sima Biao's Xu Han Shu of the Jin dynasty were combined with Fan Ye's work, creating the Book of Later Han we know today.
units.literal: During the reign of Emperor Zhenzong of the Northern Song, someone combined the thirty volumes of eight treatises from Sima Biao's 'Xu Han Shu' of the Jin dynasty with it, forming today's 'Book of Later Han'.

units.zh: 上曰：「朕受尊號謁謝，乃用故宋真宗故事，常朝服乘馬。
units.en: The emperor said, "When I received my honored title and thanked the temple, I followed former Song Emperor Zhenzong—regular court dress on horseback.
units.literal: The emperor said: "When I received my honored title and bowed in thanks, I used the former Song Emperor Zhenzong's precedent—regular court dress on horseback.

units.zh: 六年，世宗行自西京還都，禮官不知皇太子自有鹵簿金路，乃請太子就乘大駕綴路，行在天子之前。
units.en: In the sixth year, when Shizong returned from the Western Capital, ritual officials unaware that the crown prince had his own gold-chariot guard asked him to ride the imperial procession's trailing section ahead of the emperor on the road.
units.literal: In the sixth year, as Shizong returned from the Western Capital to the capital, the ritual officials did not know the crown prince had his own guard and gold chariot and asked the prince to take the great imperial procession's trailing road ahead of the Son of Heaven on the journey.

units.zh: 於是裴 、顏師古、李賢、何超、董沖諸儒，訓詁音釋，然後制度、名物、方言、奇字，可以一覽而周知。
units.en: Scholars such as Pei Yin, Yan Shigu, Li Xian, He Chao, and Dong Chong then supplied phonetic and exegetical notes, making it possible to survey institutions, material objects, regional speech, and obscure characters in a single reading and understand them completely.
units.literal: Thereupon Pei Yin, Yan Shigu, Li Xian, He Chao, Dong Chong, and other scholars provided exegetical and phonetic glosses, so that institutions, objects, dialect terms, and unusual characters could be surveyed at a glance and fully understood.

units.zh: 魏靜帝於是下御坐，就東廊，口詠範蔚宗《後漢書贊》云：「獻生不辰，身播國屯，終我四百，永作虞賓。」
units.en: Emperor Jing of Wei stepped down from the throne, went to the eastern gallery, and recited Fan Ye's encomium from the History of Later Han: "Xian was born untimely, his person cast upon the state's ordeal — ending our four hundred years, forever guest of Yu."
units.literal: Emperor Jing of Wei thereupon stepped down from the imperial seat, went to the eastern gallery, and intoned Fan Ye's encomium from the History of Later Han: "The Emperor Xian was born untimely, his person cast upon the state's ordeal — ending our four hundred years, forever to be guest of Yu."

units.zh: 崔暹，字季倫，博陵安平人，漢尚書寔之後也，世為北州著姓。
units.en: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han minister of works, and for generations a leading house of the northern provinces.
units.literal: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han Minister of Works, and for generations a prominent clan of the northern provinces.
